scope: Only additions under experiments/pathway2_image_lds_v3. Mentor meeting 2026-10-09: TRAK-aligned image-level random 50% LDS.
design: img32: 32 subsets, each keeps floor(2045*0.5)=1022 training images chosen uniformly (design seed 20261009), not grouped by patient
seeds: 42-49; full baselines harvested from the seed32 v2 reviewed run (42-44 via the stable baseline), 256 new half-data trainings
query_targets: image-mean CE (primary), Brier, 1-p_y; patient-macro weighting secondary; per-query-image and per-query-patient LDS
scores: image-level proxy -h.g_i (all seeds); image-level IF -h^T(H+gamma I)^-1 g_i (seeds 42-44, gamma 1/0.3/0.1/0.03, multi-shift Lanczos)
gates: smoke: full-horizon no-op equals frozen stable baseline; 2-epoch image-subset double replay exact; per-image gradients sum to patient gradients; query-Jacobian contraction equals direct per-image gradients
harvest: recomputed fp64 predictions equal the seed32 full cells (<=1e-10)
proxy: Jacobian-recombined macro scores equal direct macro scores (<=1e-8); patient-summed CE proxy equals LDS v1 frozen_h (<=1e-6)
score: patient-summed gamma=1 CE IF equals LDS v1 CG scores (rel L2<=1e-3, Spearman>=0.999) before any target is solved
